part.name: Integrated elongated housing with blind axial socket and side access pocket

part_functions.name: Structural housing
part_functions.function: Provides a rigid elongated body that supports and aligns an inserted cylindrical member while transferring loads to the enlarged rear section.

part_functions.name: Cylindrical member guidance
part_functions.function: The blind longitudinal socket guides, locates, and radially retains a shaft, pin, tube, or similar mating component inserted from the front.

part_functions.name: Internal access
part_functions.function: The transverse rectangular pocket provides access to, clearance for, or engagement with the longitudinal cylindrical socket.

part_functions.name: Rear load distribution

section_functions.name: Primary structural spine

section_functions.name: Front interface support
section_functions.function: The stepped and rounded front geometry surrounds the axial opening, provides insertion clearance, and reduces stress concentration at changes in the external profile.

feature_functions.name: Load-bearing envelope
feature_functions.function: The top, side, chamfer, and bottom surfaces form a continuous stiff shell around the axial socket and connect structurally to both the rear block and front nose.
